frames.narration: The pool starts empty. Nothing expensive has been created yet.
Request 1 asks for a connection. The pool creates the first one, because it is under its limit.
Requests 2 and 3 do the same. Now all three connections exist and are in use.
Request 4 asks, but the pool is at its limit. It must wait: no fourth connection is opened.
Request 1 finishes and releases its connection. The pool resets it and keeps it ready.
Request 4 gets connection #1, reused, with no new connection opened.
